pages.text: “Roots dig deep, strong and resilient, guarding against the harshest storms.”$(br2)Burdock Soup is a medicinal broth with a rich herbal flavor, made from dried burdock and sugar. The deep brown tea has a slightly bitter taste that turns sweet over time. Drinking it provides Resistance and removes Slowness effects.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Burdock Soup, $(br)boil two portions of dried burdock with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed during battle or when movement is restricted, offering travelers increased resilience.

Upon drinking Burdock Soup, travelers will receive a Resistance effect and have Slowness removed, allowing for greater mobility.$(br)This medicinal broth is perfect for defensive reinforcement.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
